messages:
maria-sre: Heads up — apiserver latency spike in eu-west3 ~10:15 UTC. p95 token latency up to ~350ms, 5xxs jumped from 0.02% -> 1.2%. Dash: https://telemetry.redwood/graphs/abc123 :thinking_face:

jordan-ctrl: saw controller-manager restart loop around the same time, gpu nodepool reconcilers fired a lot. logs show exponential backoff on scale-down attempts.

kevin-ops: autoscaler behavior looked odd — large scale-up, then immediate scale-down within ~2m. That would flood the control plane with pod lifecycle events and attach/detach ops.

anya-net: also seeing an uptick in retransmits and PMTU warnings on eu-west3 internal subnet. Possible MTU mismatch introduced by the NIC image in the new node pool. Kernel snippet: `frag_needed: mtu 1400 but path mtu 1500` in syslog.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback paused for deployment `gpu-scheduler` v2.1.3 — manual pause at 2026-03-21T10:17:00Z

oliver-sre: etcd leader flapped once during the spike (leader change observed). Follower election latency ~2s around 10:15:25 — that would delay watcher notifications to apiserver and amplify request retries.

maria-sre: attaching a tiny tail of apiserver logs (snip):
```
E0321 10:15:22.112 apiserver.go:228] POST /api/v1/namespaces/default/pods: 503 Service Unavailable
W0321 10:15:23.441 watcher.go:93] watch input buffer full: dropped 128 events
```

jordan-ctrl: makes sense. Controllers reconciling on many Node/Pod changes will requeue a lot of work. Short-term we should reduce reconcile churn by raising `--min-resync-period` for the gpu nodepool controller.

kevin-ops: immediate mitigation plan: cordon `new-gpu-pool-3` && drain with `kubectl drain new-gpu-pool-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` to stop ongoing churn. Will monitor apiserver 5xxs.

anya-net: if you cordon/drain, also add node annotation `net/migrate=false` to avoid triggering the NIC hotplug path in the problematic image while we investigate.

oliver-sre: longer term: 1) change autoscaler cooldowns to avoid rapid downscales during preemption windows, 2) raise apiserver `--max-requests-inflight` to 2000 and `--max-mutating-requests-inflight` to 200 to survive bursts, 3) validate etcd leader stability and clock skew across masters.

maria-sre: assigning actions: @jordan-ctrl to patch controller-manager flags, @kevin-ops to cordon/drain affected pool and report pod eviction progress, @anya-net to dig into NIC image/MTU. I will run an etcd health/election sweep and capture timeline. Post updates here.

kevin-ops: cordoned `new-gpu-pool-3`, drain started. Progress: evicted 12/24 pods, no pending attach errors so far.

deploy-bot: Metric update: 5xx rate reduced from 1.2% -> 0.15% after cordon/drain and throttling of reconciles.

maria-sre: thanks all — leaving this thread open until we have follow-ups and a short postmortem. :white_check_mark:
